---
title: Publications
subtitle: Selected papers and preprints
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
---

```{r results='asis', echo=FALSE}
pubs <- bib2df::bib2df("bibliography/publications.bib")
pubs <- pubs[, c(1, 2, 5, 10, 13, 17, 19, 20, 23, 25, 26, 27, 28, 29, 30)]
pubs$YEAR <- as.numeric(pubs$YEAR)
pubs <- pubs[order(pubs$YEAR, decreasing = TRUE), ]

format_authors <- function(authors) {
  if (length(authors) == 0 || all(is.na(authors))) return("")
  paste(authors, collapse = ", ")
}

print_publication <- function(entry) {
  cat("::: {.publication}\n")
  cat(
    '<div class="publication-title">',
    entry$TITLE,
    "</div>\n",
    sep = ""
  )

  meta <- paste(
    format_authors(entry$AUTHOR),
    entry$JOURNAL,
    entry$YEAR,
    sep = " · "
  )

  cat(
    '<div class="publication-meta">',
    meta,
    "</div>\n\n",
    sep = ""
  )

  links <- character()

  if (!is.na(entry$DOI) && nzchar(entry$DOI)) {
    links <- c(
      links,
      sprintf("[DOI](https://doi.org/%s)", entry$DOI)
    )
  }

  if (!is.na(entry$URL) && nzchar(entry$URL)) {
    links <- c(
      links,
      sprintf("[Paper](%s)", entry$URL)
    )
  }

  if (length(links) > 0) {
    cat(paste(links, collapse = " · "), "\n")
  }

  cat(":::\n\n")
}

cat("## Working papers and preprints\n\n")

preprints <- pubs[
  grepl("preprint", pubs$KEYWORDS, ignore.case = TRUE),
]

for (i in seq_len(nrow(preprints))) {
  print_publication(preprints[i, ])
}

cat("## Publications\n\n")

published <- pubs[
  grepl("published", pubs$KEYWORDS, ignore.case = TRUE),
]

for (i in seq_len(nrow(published))) {
  print_publication(published[i, ])
}
```
